## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md contains a 'Reconciler orchestrator' section
  Verify: grep -qE '^## .*Reconciler [Oo]rchestrator' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] Section enumerates all 4 Mode members (dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live)
  Verify: for m in dry-run bootstrap-strict bootstrap-throttle live; do grep -q \"$m\" .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] Section documents .reconciler-pass-lock as advisory + complement to workflow cancel-in-progress
  Verify: grep -q '.reconciler-pass-lock' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md && grep -q 'cancel-in-progress' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] Section documents .reconciler-phase-gate removal as advance step (bootstrap-strict → bootstrap-throttle)
  Verify: grep -q '.reconciler-phase-gate' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
- [ ] Section enumerates all 9 dispatch leaves
  Verify: for leaf in inbound_create inbound_update inbound_delete inbound_clean_label inbound_repair_property inbound_probe outbound_create outbound_update outbound_delete; do grep -q \"$leaf\" .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] Story id 9e3f-3208-af65-4b34 referenced
  Verify: grep -F '9e3f-3208-af65-4b34' .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md

## Implementation Notes
Append a 'Reconciler orchestrator' section to .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md covering:
1. **Mode flag** — rationale (rollout-safety knob, fail-fast pre-fetcher, no --force override) and the 4 allowed members.
2. **Pass-lock** — .reconciler-pass-lock is advisory (tickets-branch file); complements GHA cancel-in-progress: false at .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml:21-23; second invocation observes via git show tickets:.reconciler-pass-lock and exits non-zero pre-fetcher; acquire/release uses _concurrency.rebase_retry pattern.
3. **Phase-gate** — .reconciler-phase-gate (presence-based on tickets branch). Operator removes the file from tickets to advance bootstrap-strict → bootstrap-throttle. Exact removal command: `git checkout tickets && git rm .reconciler-phase-gate && git commit -m 'advance phase gate' && git checkout -`.
4. **9-leaf dispatch table** — table of all 9 (direction, action) leaves mapping to applier symbols.
5. **Drift modes vs rollout modes** — inject-and-heal.sh's --mode=orphan|mislabel|missing-prop is a SHELL SCRIPT PARAMETER (case statement), NOT a reconcile.py CLI flag. The two namespaces are orthogonal.
6. Reference story id 9e3f-3208-af65-4b34.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
